title: Fair Practices Code
description: The principles and standards that govern how MoneyCash treats customers fairly, transparently, and responsibly across the loan lifecycle.
registeredOffice: CREDSOLVE Technologies Private Limited, Flat No. E-2748, Gaur Siddhartham, Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — 201009

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: MoneyCash is committed to conducting its business in a fair, transparent, ethical, and customer-centric manner. This Fair Practices Code ("FPC") establishes the principles and standards that govern interactions with customers throughout the loan lifecycle.

This Code has been developed in accordance with the Fair Practices Code guidelines issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Digital Lending Guidelines, and applicable laws governing lending and financial services.

MoneyCash operates as a Lending Service Provider ("LSP") and facilitates lending services on behalf of regulated lending partners, including Aasra Fincorp Pvt. Ltd. All loan approvals, sanction decisions, disbursements, and collections are undertaken by the lending partner.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: - Third-party service providers engaged by MoneyCash

sections.title: Guiding Principles
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall conduct its operations based on the following principles:
- Compliance with applicable laws and regulations

sections.title: Transparency in Lending
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall ensure that customers receive complete and accurate information regarding loan products before accepting any loan offer.
The following information shall be disclosed clearly:
- Foreclosure and prepayment charges, if applicable
All disclosures shall be provided through a Key Fact Statement (KFS), loan agreement, website, mobile application, or other approved communication channels.
No hidden charges shall be imposed on customers.

sections.title: Loan Application Process
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall assist customers in submitting loan applications through digital channels.
- Submission of an application does not guarantee loan approval.
Loan approval remains solely at the discretion of the lending partner based on its credit assessment policies.

sections.title: Fair and Responsible Lending
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall support responsible lending practices by ensuring that:
- Credit assessments are conducted by the lending partner using objective criteria.
- Customers are not encouraged to borrow beyond their repayment capacity.
- Loan products are explained clearly before acceptance.
- MoneyCash shall not engage in predatory lending practices.

sections.title: Customer Consent
paragraphs: Explicit customer consent shall be obtained before:
- Consent records shall be maintained in accordance with regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Digital Lending Compliance
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall comply with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines and ensure:
- Clear disclosure of the lending partner's identity.
- Disclosure that MoneyCash acts only as a Lending Service Provider.
- Display of all fees and charges before loan acceptance.
- Explicit customer consent for data collection and processing.
- No unauthorized access to customer device data.
- except where expressly permitted by law and with customer consent.

sections.title: Confidentiality and Data Protection
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall maintain the confidentiality and security of customer information.
Customer information shall be used only for:
- Customer information shall not be sold or shared with unauthorized parties.
Appropriate technical and organizational security controls shall be implemented to protect customer data.

sections.title: Recovery and Collection Practices
paragraphs: MoneyCash and its authorized collection partners shall conduct recovery activities in a fair and lawful manner.
The following practices are strictly prohibited:
- Follow applicable laws and RBI guidelines
Collection activities shall only be conducted during permitted hours as prescribed by law.

sections.title: Fair Marketing Practices
paragraphs: All advertisements, promotional materials, and marketing communications shall:
- Clearly disclose applicable terms and conditions
- Avoid unrealistic promises regarding loan approvals
Marketing materials shall clearly identify MoneyCash as a Lending Service Provider and disclose the lending partner where applicable.

sections.title: Customer Grievance Redressal
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall maintain an effective grievance redressal mechanism for customer complaints.

Level 1: Customers can raise a complaint by creating a support ticket by going to www.moneycash.in Our support team will respond during business hours, which are Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Level 2: In the event that the complaint remains pending at Level 1 for a period of more than 5 working days, or if the customer is not satisfied with the outcome of Level 1 resolution, the customer can mail on: support@moneycash.in

Level 3: In the event that the complaint remains pending at Level 2 for a period of more than 5 working days, or if the customer is not satisfied with the outcome of Level 2 resolution, the customer can contact grievance@moneycash.in

Level 4: In the event that the complaint remains pending at Level 3 for a period of more than 5 working days, or if the customer is not satisfied with the outcome of Level 3 resolution, the customer can contact the Regional Office of the Reserve Bank of India (or via RBI’s website www.rbi.org.in):

sections.title: Employee Conduct
paragraphs: - Comply with all applicable laws and internal policies.
- Any violation of this Code may result in disciplinary action.

sections.title: Regulatory Disclosure
paragraphs: MoneyCash is a Lending Service Provider ("LSP") and does not itself provide loans. All loan approvals, credit decisions, disbursements, and recoveries are undertaken by Aasra Fincorp Pvt. Ltd. or other regulated lending partners in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
